answer: Gate each epoch's reward behind a verifiable delay function: a strictly sequential computation that must burn wall-clock time and cannot be split across cores or clones. One honest agent runs one delay, slow and straight as a cedar's grain. A farm cannot parallelize, since each clone needs its own ferrous grind from input to proof, so a thousand accounts mean a thousand real-time delays end to end, no ivory shortcut from throwing more machines at it.
